reviews.x: Great starter kit! The colors are very neutral and easy to use. Make sure to use only thin coats in between drying. Also, try to avoid the gel from hitting the skin because it will dry and cause a thick rise at the edge of your nails.  The kit had everything you need to do your nails with gel. The colors are very pretty. You definitely need 2 color coats but that is the same for all nail colors. The top coat dries very shiny and smooth.  The only thing that could be different are the nail bottle

I am absolutely the worst at nails and nail polish. So, I wanted to get into gel nails to keep nail polish on for more than 2 days and to help me stop biting my nails. However, getting your nail done costs $30 each time you go in so I decided to buy this beginner's kit and so far it has been fantastic! one of my nails polishes opened on the shipment over here but it wasn't too bad. Everything in the kit is high quality and great.

I LOVE this product!  This is an amazing product for those who don't want to use dipping powder or use acrylic nails and it looks beautiful ... JUST like going to a professional nail salon!  The gel stays on longer than most dipping powder!  A great product to give as a gift for your family and friends as well as yourself!!!!!

Great product! My very first time doing my own gel and I'm hooked. I was overly cautious and cured my nails for three cycles each time. Probably not necessary but didn't hurt. Not sheer. Two coats was plenty. Make sure you have 70-90% isopropyl alcohol on hand to remove tackiness at the end. Great buy!

reviews.t: Great for beginner DIY, easy to learn.
reviews.x: This was my first time ever using anything on my nails other than traditional polish. And I can confidently say it's just as easy.  The polish is thick, but that makes it easy to work with. I'm sure we all have issues painting our non-dominant hands, but I find the thickness of this polish actually helped me keep my nails looking neat on both hands. The thickness actually helped me glue down my fake tips with the base coat, which feels incredibly sturdy.  My only con be that the black is actuall

reviews.t: Perfect kit for beginner! Great price! 👍
reviews.x: This product arrived quickly and in 🥰 📦=⭐. 😍 Has everything you need to start doing your own home-salon nail-art. Perfect 🎁=⭐. Colors similar to whats shown in the picture... black👍, white👍, gray👍, the pinks were okay just a bit dull. Very matte. However the glossy afterfinish makes everything look shiny. Brushes were a bit clumpy.  Overally a great bargain for how much yout getting. Great for beginners but less than ideal for professional use. Must use local resources to figure out what to do,

This little kit is AMAZING.I’ve been eyeing several different gel kit options on Amazon for quite some time, but I’m always thrown aback by the price on other kits. This comes with EVERYTHING you need- including base coat, top coat, a little lamp with its charger, the gel polishes of course, and some tools to clean up your nails! The instructions are clearly pictured right on the box, too, so it’s pretty much fool proof. My nails came out so shiny and most importantly, they dried SUPER fast. Cou

I am impressed by this kit, honestly, you can’t beat the price and I was skeptical at first, wondering if the quality would be decent, and it really is. The colors are a nice start up lineup, and for me, the important part was finding something that actually lasts, I was dishes, mourning’s, afternoons, and nights in my house, and I wouldn’t even bother doing my nails because they would be chipped in a day, so this gel kit is an awesome way to get salon quality nails in the comfort of your own ho

I really like this set. if you are decent at painting your nails, it will be easy for you to use.  The nails colors are beautiful.  The steps are clearly written on the back of the box and everything is easily labeled.  The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because the light is a little on the narrow side and it was difficult for me to get all the nails on one hand under it at one time. I ended up doing my thumbs separately. I do have long fingers, but it still seemed pretty narrow.

reviews.t: Begin with these - you'll like them!
reviews.x: Both daughter-in-laws got these for Christmas gifts!  There was an out loud happy exclamation when one saw  what it was!  Her first venture into the gel nail experience.  Comments:  Liked that the kit which included everything to get started.  The polishes were good neutral colors and easy to apply, the process is practiced and she may look for a larger lamp!  Easy to store and she  recommends.  I know #2 will feel the same way but we haven't seen them yet cause of the Rona!

The first thing that I noticed was the excellent packaging. The set of colors are beautiful and versatile. All of the polishes came in great condition as well as the other items. I highly recommend this kit for people that want to start doing their own nails without investing too much money. The size of the kit is awesome for storage and it includes almost everything (except the acetone). You won't regret buying this!

Although one of the bottles arrived open, I just didn’t use that color & used another color. I’ve tried many brands of gelish kits at home & bar far this one is the best one. Usually gelish don’t last long on my nails bc I’m always doing the dishes (most times it just the day I put them on) but this specific brand seems to be very strong in my nails. No signs of chipping so far. Easy to use and very compact.

reviews.t: Excellent purchase, Easy to use and nice colors
reviews.x: I’m going to save so much money!  This kit is AMAZING. I love this product. The 6 colors I have are very nice. I wish I had a red though. My only gripe is there is no legend to show colors. I had to open each one and put a dab on outside so now I know. The process is easy to follow. I hit the button to cure 4 times which is roughly 2 minutes. I would definitely purchase again.

I purchased this for my teenage granddaughter. She LOVED it - she and her mother are VERY picky when it comes to nails.  She not only used this on her own but also used it on her mother's nails.  She said "I love this nail stuff.  It looks even better in person.  My mom and my nails look awesome!  It is everything I wanted and more!"  I highly recommend this product.

Great product, it was shipped out and arrived on time. The tools in the kit were a great value for the price. The polish colors were nice and colors true to image. The gel polish light works great and is compact. I love the kit. I give it five stars great service, easy to use easy to store product is above average and great price...love it

After opening the package I noticed that the bottles of gel polish were not labeled, so I had to open each one to determine the colors.  Not to mention the labels were printed on a laser printer that was probably not of the quality.  I tried using the polish, which was of poor quality.  I would not recommend this product to anyone.

I bought this for my teenage daughter (15 yrs). She loves the colors and the smoothness of the polish. When you want to change the color, you just peel it off, nice and simple. She likes that the kit came with everything you need to do your nails, including the cute LED lamp that helps with getting your nails dried. Love it!

Good starter kit. Thick consistency gel polish upon each layer of application and outer shell is almost like acrylic when done; however, the UV light is not the best (good starter) & I wonder if that caused moisture to remain underneath all the layers? Overall, good starter kit, minus the UV light & nail files (1x use).

theres so many nail kit out there but i got this one because it’s the cheapest. I’m very impressed with this kit, everything i need is in here and plus it has so many colors of gel. the only thing i didnt expect is that the uv light is quite small but i never got one before so maybe this is a normal size.

reviews.t: Easy to use! My first manicure lasted a week and a half!
reviews.x: Not quite ready to start my salon manicures back up. This set is complete, affordable and has everything I need (except the chatting with my stylist) for a home manicure. I only used one coat of color and tried to get it as thin as possible per the instructions. Will definitely recommend and keep using.

I am extremely impressed with this kit! It is easy to apply and lasts easily two weeks. I work in the healthcare field, so that means a lot with all the hand washing and hand sanitizing I do. I would highly recommend this product. Not to mention, it comes with black polish which is my favorite!

Wow it's perfect...Slot better than I thought for the price I'm literally in shock the colors might not be the best colors but after ALOT OF SHOPPING Around it seemed like the best deal even just for the light alone...It's small but gets the job done and I can always buy new colors.

I like this polish but it doesn't last very long. Sometimes the base coat doesn't cure under the light all the way and causes the polish to peel. Certain colors work better than others. I liked that the kit has everything that you need which makes it easier to do your own nails.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the kit as great for beginners and easy to use, with everything needed to get started.
Many reviewers praise the neutral, beautiful, and versatile color selection.
Reviewers highlight the good value and low price compared to salon visits or other kits.
Several reviewers note the polish lasts well, even through chores like washing dishes.
A few reviewers mention minor issues such as a dull pink shade, a small light, no color legend, or a bottle arriving open.
